 India (in blue) is coming into the match after beating Pakistan and is looking to secure its 10th SAFF Championship title.
 Welcome to Sportstar’s live coverage of the SAFF Championship 2026 match between India and the Maldives, being played in Bangladesh.  
 India is the defending champion and the most successful team in the tournament, and is aiming to secure its 10th title. 
 Match overview: 
 Venue: National Stadium in Dhaka, Bangladesh
 Kick-off time: 3:30 pm local time (3:00 pm IST)
 India starting XI: Priyansh Dubey (gk), C Singh Konsham (c), Sandip Mandi, Muhammed Uvais Moyikkal, Khaiminthang Lhungdim, Abhishek Suryavanshi, Ricky John Shabong, Macarton Louis Nickson, Brison Deuben, Abdul Rabeeh, Suhail Ahmad Bhat
 Maldives starting XI: Hussain Shareef (gk), Samooh Ali (c), Hussain Sifaau Yoosuf, Ibrahim Aisam, Ahmed Aiham, Ahmed Aiham, Amdhan Ali, Ibrahim Mahudhee Hussain, Hassan Eenaaz, Naiz Hassan, Nisham Mohamed Rasheed
 November 11, 2026 14:54 
 What does India need to do?
 India just needs to walk away with a point to ensure that it finishes above Pakistan in Group B. 
 But surely Noushan Moosa will be eager for his team to make a statement in their hunt for a record-extending 10th title.

 November 11, 2026 13:46 
 India vs Maldives - Match preview!
 The Indian men’s football team will take on New Zealand in an international friendly at the Go Media Stadium in Auckland on Thursday.
 This will be the first of the two friendlies between the two sides in this international window to mark 100 years of connection between the two nations through sport.
 Khalid Jamil has named a much-changed squad for the friendlies from the last window, where India played Panama, Brazil and Uruguay.
 Captain and senior goalkeeper Gurpreet Singh Sandhu was dropped from the squad, while Som Kumar, Ricky Meetei Haobam, Lalremtluanga Fanai and Tomba Singh Haobam have all earned call ups.
 Bijoy Varghese, Muhammad Suhail and Liston Colaco have left the ongoing SAFF championship, where India is fielding a second-string side, to link up to the senior for the two friendlies.
 While India is ranked 138 in the world, New Zealand is 88th.
